$comment: Provider sends the Agreement directly - IDS Protocol ContractAgreementMessage. Per DSP 2025-1 (specifications/negotiation/contract.negotiation.protocol.md), this message is always Provider-sent - renamed here from UC6's agreement-acceptance.json, whose name and $comment incorrectly implied the Consumer sends this message. On this fast path there is no prior OFFERED message and no separate Consumer ACCEPTED event: this is the Provider's first and only message after the initial ContractRequestMessage, taking the negotiation straight from REQUESTED to AGREED.

constraints: Legal address country code must equal PL
